decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With appropriate safeguardign conditions, the proposed extension, would be acceptable due to its position, design and appearance. The development would not harm the appearance of the area, neighbours' living conditions or highway safety and complies with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 5 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 48 Heathdale Avenue.

Condition : 6 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the western or eastern wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 8 - The existing front canopy adjoining the site of the extension shall be removed as part of the building works before the extension hereby approved is occupied.
description: Erection of a two storey side extension, part first floor rear extension, single storey rear extension and roof extension to house.
